records.literal_gloss: For the director. A psalm of David.

en.L: For the director. A psalm of David.
en.B: For the music director. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur. Un psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Un psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Un chant de David.

decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.
As in 3:1, Readable says what a psalm is.

source.text: יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם׀אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: May YHWH answer you in [the] day of trouble; may [the] name of [the] God of Jacob set you on high.

en.L: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answer you in [the] day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob set you on high.
en.B: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answer you when trouble comes; may the God of Jacob, by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, keep you safe on the heights.
en.R: We pray that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will answer you when you are in trouble. May the God of Jacob protect you by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power.

fr.L: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te réponde au jour de la détresse ; que le nom du Dieu de Jacob te place en haut lieu.
fr.B: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te réponde quand vient la détresse ; que le Dieu de Jacob, par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, te garde en sûreté sur les hauteurs.
fr.R: Nous prions pour que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te réponde quand tu es dans le malheur. Que le Dieu de Jacob te protège par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance.

decisions.reason: The psalm is a prayer of the people ("we", verse 6) for their king (verses 7 and 10), probably before he goes out to battle. Psalm 21 gives thanks for the answer.

decisions.choice: set you on high: put you out of reach
decisions.reason: The verb (sagav) means to set high and safe, as in a stronghold on a height (9:10). The name of God is God himself, present and acting for his people.
Readable makes clear that the people are praying for the king (m1).
Readable says what the name stands for here (m2).

decisions.choice: the king is addressed with "tu", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: In this psalm the people pray for the king (m1), so "tu" and "te" are ordinary pronouns for a man; only the pronouns for God carry the setting.

records.literal_gloss: May he send your help from [the] sanctuary, and from Zion may he support you.

en.L: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} send your help from the sanctuary, and from Zion may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sustain you.
en.B: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} send you help from the holy place and hold you up from Zion.
en.R: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} send help to you from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple. May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} give you strength from Mount Zion.

fr.L: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’envoie ton secours du sanctuaire, et que de Sion {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te soutienne.
fr.B: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’envoie de l’aide du lieu saint et te soutienne depuis Sion.
fr.R: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’envoie de l’aide de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te donne des forces depuis le mont Sion.

decisions.choice: the sanctuary, Zion: where God is present
decisions.reason: The sanctuary on Mount Zion in Jerusalem was where the ark stood and God was present among his people; help comes to the king from there.
Readable names the holy place as God's temple and Zion as a mountain (m1).

records.literal_gloss: May he remember all your offerings, and your burnt offering may he find fat. Selah.

en.L: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remember all your grain offerings, and your burnt offering may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} accept as rich. Selah
en.B: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remember every gift you have offered and look with favor on your burnt offerings. Selah
en.R: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remember all the gifts you have given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} accept the offerings you burn on the altar. Selah

fr.L: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se souvienne de toutes tes offrandes végétales, et que ton holocauste, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’accepte comme gras. Sélah
fr.B: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se souvienne de tous les dons que tu as offerts et regarde avec faveur tes holocaustes. Sélah
fr.R: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se souvienne de tous les dons que tu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} as faits. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} accepte les offrandes que tu brûles sur l’autel. Sélah

decisions.reason: The word (minchah) means a gift, and in the law the grain offering (Leviticus 2:1). Before battle the king offered sacrifices (1 Samuel 13:9).

decisions.choice: find fat: accept as a rich offering
decisions.reason: The verb means to make or count fat; the fat was the best part, which belonged to the LORD (Leviticus 3:16). To find an offering fat is to accept it with pleasure.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.
Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

records.literal_gloss: May he give to you according to your heart, and all your plan[s] may he fulfill.

en.L: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} give you according to your heart, and all your plans may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fulfill.
en.B: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} grant you what your heart desires and bring every plan of yours to pass.
en.R: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} give you what you really want. May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let every one of your plans work out.

fr.L: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te donne selon ton cœur, et que tous tes projets, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les accomplisse.
fr.B: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’accorde ce que ton cœur désire et mène à bien chacun de tes projets.
fr.R: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te donne ce que tu veux vraiment. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse réussir chacun de tes projets.

decisions.choice: according to your heart: what you desire
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of desire and purpose. Psalm 21:3 says that God has given the king the desire of his heart.

decisions.choice: plan: counsel, a plan of action
decisions.reason: The word ('etsah) is the counsel of 1:1; here the king's plans for the battle.

source.text: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה׀בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let us shout for joy at your victory, and in [the] name of our God let us set up banners. May YHWH fulfill all your requests.

en.L: Let us shout for joy at your victory, and in the name of our God let us lift banners. May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} fulfill all your requests.
en.B: We will shout for joy when you win the day, and we will raise our banners in our God's name. May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} give you all you ask for.
en.R: Then we will shout for joy because you have won. We will wave our flags to honor our God. We pray that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give you everything you ask for.

fr.L: Crions de joie pour ta victoire, et au nom de notre Dieu levons les bannières. Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} accomplisse toutes tes demandes.
fr.B: Nous crierons de joie quand tu remporteras la victoire, et nous lèverons nos bannières au nom de notre Dieu. Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donne tout ce que tu demandes.
fr.R: Alors nous crierons de joie parce que tu auras gagné. Nous agiterons nos drapeaux pour honorer notre Dieu. Nous prions pour que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donne tout ce que tu demandes.

decisions.choice: your victory: the king's rescue and victory
decisions.reason: The word (yeshu'ah) means rescue, salvation, and in battle victory. It is the king's victory, given by God (verse 7).

alternatives: let us be great (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for a banner (degel, Numbers 2:2): the people raise their standards in celebration. The ancient Greek translation read a different verb, "we will be made great".

decisions.choice: let us shout, let us set up: a resolve
decisions.reason: The verbs express what the people mean to do; they are sure of the answer.

decisions.choice: wave our flags to honor our God
alternatives: set up banners in the name of our God
decisions.reason: Readable says the same in plain words (m2).

source.text: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ׀יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Now I know that YHWH saves his anointed; he answers him from [the] heavens of his holiness with [the] mighty deeds of [the] salvation of his right hand.

en.L: Now I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saves {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will answer him from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy heavens with the mighty deeds of the saving [power] of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand.
en.B: Now I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brings {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed king through safely; from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy heaven {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will answer him with the mighty saving acts of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand.
en.R: Now I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rescues the king {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has chosen. From {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy home in heaven, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will answer him. With {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will save him.

fr.L: Maintenant je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sauve {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui répondra de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} cieux saints par les exploits du salut de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite.
fr.B: Maintenant je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait traverser le danger au roi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a oint ; de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ciel saint {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui répondra par les puissantes délivrances de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite.
fr.R: Maintenant je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} délivre le roi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi. De {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte demeure dans le ciel, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui répondra. Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le sauvera.

decisions.reason: After the people's prayer a single voice speaks, perhaps a priest or prophet, or the king himself, sure that the prayer has been heard.
The king was anointed with oil as the one God had chosen (1 Samuel 16:13; Psalm 2:2).
The verb is in the past form: the rescue is so certain that it can be spoken of as done.

decisions.choice: his right hand: his power in action
decisions.reason: The right hand is the strong hand, and stands for power (Exodus 15:6).
Readable says what "anointed" means here (m2).

source.text: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ׀בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: These in chariots and these in horses, but we in [the] name of YHWH our God make mention.

en.L: These [boast] in chariots and those in horses, but we in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God make mention.
en.B: Some count on chariots, some on horses; we call on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God by name.
en.R: Some people depend on their war chariots. Others depend on their horses. But we pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God and depend on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Ceux-ci [se vantent] de chars et ceux-là de chevaux, mais nous, du nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous faisons mention.
fr.B: Les uns comptent sur leurs chars, les autres sur leurs chevaux ; nous, nous invoquons le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu.
fr.R: Certains comptent sur leurs chars de guerre. D’autres comptent sur leurs chevaux. Mais nous, nous prions {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu et nous comptons sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

decisions.reason: The first two lines have no verb; it is supplied from the last: they make mention of (that is, boast of or rely on) chariots and horses.

decisions.choice: make mention: call on, boast of
decisions.reason: The verb (zakar, in this form) means to call to mind or name aloud, as in calling on a god in worship (Exodus 23:13). Israel names the LORD as its strength.

decisions.choice: chariots and horses: the strength of armies
decisions.reason: Chariots and horses were the strongest weapons of the time; Israel's kings were not to multiply horses (Deuteronomy 17:16; Isaiah 31:1).
Literal brackets the verb the first lines lack (m1).
Readable makes the contrast with chariots and horses plain (m2).

source.text: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: They bow down and fall, but we rise and stand upright.

en.L: They have bowed down and fallen, but we have risen and stand upright.
en.B: They will buckle and fall, but we will get up and stand our ground.
en.R: Those enemies will stumble and fall. But we will get up and stand strong.

fr.L: Eux, ils ont plié et sont tombés, mais nous, nous nous sommes relevés et nous tenons debout.
fr.B: Eux plieront et tomberont, mais nous, nous nous relèverons et tiendrons bon.
fr.R: Ces ennemis trébucheront et tomberont. Mais nous, nous nous relèverons et nous resterons debout, solides.

decisions.choice: they have fallen, we have risen: as good as done
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the past form, describing the coming battle as already decided; "they" are those who rely on chariots and horses.
The verb ("ud", in this form) means to stand up straight or be restored.
Balanced and Readable put in the future what is sure to happen (m1).
Readable says who "they" are (m1).

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, save! May the King answer us in [the] day we call.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, save! May the King answer us on the day we call.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, save! May the King answer us when we cry out.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, save us! May God our King answer us when we call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve ! Que le Roi nous réponde au jour où nous appelons.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve ! Que le Roi nous réponde quand nous crions vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve-nous ! Que Dieu notre Roi nous réponde quand nous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelons.

decisions.choice: save! May the King answer us
alternatives: save the king! May he answer us (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text divides the verse after "save", so that "the King" who answers is the LORD himself. The ancient Greek translation joins the words differently, "LORD, save the king, and answer us", which matches the prayer for the king in verses 2-7.
Readable supplies the object of "save" and says that the King is God (m1).
